annotation.title_clean: Ley de Fomento a Inteligencia Artificial y Tecnologías (Decreto N.º 234)
annotation.title_en: Law for the Promotion of Artificial Intelligence and Technologies (Decree No. 234)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Asamblea Legislativa de la República de El Salvador
annotation.summary_en: El Salvador's 2025 AI promotion law creates the National AI Agency (ANIA) and a national registry, grants safeguards (liability exemptions, sandbox protections, open-data and open-source freedoms) to registered actors, and requires disclosure and human appeal of AI-driven decisions. It is innovation-oriented, with only a passing mention of robots as autonomous systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Agencia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (ANIA) as lead authority for AI promotion.
Establishes a National Registry of AI Development, Innovation and Application; registration grants legal safeguards.
Requires informing users whether decisions are AI-made or AI-driven, with explanation and human appeal.
Exempts sandbox/research activities and developers from liability for third-party misuse if reasonable efforts shown.
ANIA to set a risk assessment framework, mandatory only for systems handling confidential or personal data.
